method: Generated a deterministic synthetic CRAFT snapshot with the Python encoder, then parsed the du payload using native du.Y and the eTb/eTo account-state reader from the installed JAR; offline, no UI or live packet injection.

isolated_postgres_regressions.execution: Docker unittest gate on isolated wakemu_migration_test schemas; no live migration.

checks: Existing seed stack reuses UID and returns native 12470 quantity delta.
Full base inventory rejects a product with no matching stack without changing inventory.
Full base inventory still merges an existing compatible seed stack.
Stack overflow uses a free slot; rejects without a free slot.
Another character's stack is never merged.
Caller transaction rollback reverts the item grant.
Boolean inputs and unknown stack references fail before SQL.
schema_array_checks: account_professions.actions rejects NULL elements and multidimensional arrays.
harvest_product_inventory_regressions.execution: Docker unittest gate against fresh isolated PostgreSQL schemas; no runtime or live database changes.

limits: The golden is a synthetic deterministic fixture accepted by the native parser, not an observed official account packet.
No live server, GUI, or production database was used.
